query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recettes) as total_recettes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terroirs) as total_terroirs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules_recettes) as molecule_recette_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules) as plant_molecule_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT moleculeId) FROM molecules_recettes) as molecules_with_recettes,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT moleculeId) FROM plant_molecules) as molecules_with_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plantId) FROM plant_molecules) as plants_with_molecules;
